scope: CPU regression tests; no browser, GPU run, screenshot or visual acceptance

results.name: Regression demonstrates that the old reset drifts
Exact overview pose survives 120 frames of prior rotate/pan momentum
Exact detail pose survives 120 frames of prior rotate/pan momentum
Exact top pose survives 120 frames of prior rotate/pan momentum
Pose helper restores controls flags after a failed resize
Repeated bfcache cycles preserve the scene and refresh its size
Ordinary pageshow does not trigger unnecessary resize, listener unbind works
Batching preserves triangle count and cuts mesh submissions by at least 85%
Transparent wineglasses and switchable candle flames stay independent
cutaway/neutral: every visible triangle, material, normal, UV and render flag is preserved
cutaway/warm: every visible triangle, material, normal, UV and render flag is preserved
full/neutral: every visible triangle, material, normal, UV and render flag is preserved
full/warm: every visible triangle, material, normal, UV and render flag is preserved
floor/neutral: every visible triangle, material, normal, UV and render flag is preserved
floor/warm: every visible triangle, material, normal, UV and render flag is preserved
All merged bounds remain finite and contain every vertex
Batching is idempotent and preserves independently visible wall groups
